run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-15T13:45:52Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend error-rate alert is explained by a product-catalog outage that began with the product-catalog Deployment rollout at 13:44:01Z. The rolled-out pod template sets the container command to ["invalid-command"], so every new product-catalog container fails at start with 'exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH' (StartError, exit code 128) and enters CrashLoopBackOff; the old ReplicaSet was scaled to 0, the Deployment reports no available/ready replicas, and the product-catalog Service has only a notReadyAddress. Product-catalog server spans drop from ~9.5-10.0 GetProduct spans/s to 0 in the 13:45:52-13:50:52 bucket. Frontend error spans (4,210.86 increase over the window) are confined to the product-catalog-dependent paths: grpc ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (770.61), RecommendationService/ListRecommendations (142.16), CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (105.77) plus their HTTP routes and tcp.connect (11.30); frontend client calls to AdService, CartService show 0 error increase. Recommendation (295.38 error spans, incl. its ProductCatalogService/ListProducts client span) and checkout (183.35 error spans, incl. its ProductCatalogService/GetProduct client span) fail in their own spans on the same dependency, and frontend-proxy error spans rise on ingress/router frontend egress at the same time. Fraud-detection's OOMKill restart at 13:34:04Z was examined and is not tied to this cause (0 error spans, restart precedes error onset).

claims.text: frontend accumulated approximately 4,210.86 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans in the window, broken down by operation: GET 1038.22, GET /api/products/{productId} 770.61, executing api route (pages) /api/products/[productId] 770.61, grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 770.61, GET /api/recommendations 142.16, executing api route (pages) /api/recommendations 142.16, grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations 142.16, POST /api/checkout 105.74, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout 105.77, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 105.77, POST 105.74, tcp.connect 11.30.

In the same frontend error series, frontend's other client spans show no error activity: grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart and grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem each report STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase 0, as do GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart and GET /api/data. The error increase is concentrated in calls that depend on product-catalog.

frontend error rates were 0 through the 13:40:52Z bucket, then GET errors were 1.2/s at 13:45:52Z and 5.11/s at 13:50:52Z; GET /api/products/{productId} 4.30/s, GET /api/recommendations 0.81/s, POST /api/checkout 0.51/s and tcp.connect 0.033/s then 0.0147/s all first became non-zero in the 13:45:52Z/13:50:52Z buckets.

Pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l is phase Running but Ready=False (reason ContainersNotReady, 'containers with unready status: [product-catalog]'), container ready=false, restartCount=5, state waiting reason CrashLoopBackOff with message 'back-off 2m40s restarting failed container=product-catalog', and lastState terminated with exitCode 128, reason StartError, message 'failed to create containerd task: ... exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH'.

The product-catalog Deployment (generation 4) defines container command ["invalid-command"] with image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog, and its status conditions include Available=False reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable message 'Deployment does not have minimum availability.'; the deployments table shows product-catalog DESIRED=1 with AVAILABLE and READY unset (<none>) while all other otel-demo deployments show 1 available/1 ready.

Events show the rollout: Deployment product-catalog 'Scaled up replica set product-catalog-fcf7564cf from 0 to 1' at 13:44:01Z, ReplicaSet fcf7564cf 'Created pod: product-catalog-fcf7564cf-2fvnx' at 13:44:01Z, Warning Failed 'exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH' at 13:44:05Z (count 2) and 13:44:22Z (count 6), Warning BackOff 'Back-off restarting failed container product-catalog' count 25, and 'Scaled down replica set product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc from 1 to 0' at 13:44:10Z.

ReplicaSets owned by product-catalog: product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc created 2026-11-15T13:14:00Z with replicas 0 and no command override, and product-catalog-fcf7564cf created 2026-11-15T13:44:01Z with replicas 1 and command [["invalid-command"]]; both use the same image string ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog, so the failing change is a pod-template configuration change rather than a different image tag.

The product-catalog Service endpoints object contains only notReadyAddresses (pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l, uid 7fe244c1-132e-4046-b822-b0a8f8388955, port tcp-service 8080) and no ready addresses.

product-catalog server span rates were 9.48, 10.04, 9.67 and 7.85 spans/s for oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and 0.76, 0.85, 0.83 and 0.69 spans/s for oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts in the buckets ending 13:30:52Z through 13:45:52Z, then 0 for both in the bucket ending 13:50:52Z.

Downstream callers fail in their own spans on the product-catalog dependency: recommendation has 295.38 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans, including its client span /oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts (146.15) and internal span get_product_list (146.15), while its server span oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations shows only STATUS_CODE_UNSET; checkout has 183.35 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans, including oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (91.68) and its client span oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (91.68).

frontend-proxy shows its own error spans whose rate rises with the incident: span 'ingress' error rate was 0.0074/s, 0.0037/s, 0.0037/s in earlier buckets, then 1.344/s at 13:45:52Z and 5.601/s at 13:50:52Z, and span 'router frontend egress' 1.337/s then 5.594/s; checkout's PlaceOrder and ProductCatalogService/GetProduct error rates were 0 at 13:45:52Z and 0.503/s at 13:50:52Z.
The frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5 is Running, ready=true with restartCount 0 and start time 2026-11-15T13:14:01Z, so the frontend container itself was not restarting during the incident.

Services with no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series returned at all in the window include cart, currency, email, image-provider, quote and shipping (each nonetheless shows non-zero total span activity: cart 23029.69, currency 2091.83, email 2928.77, quote 2196.58, shipping 2196.58, image-provider 135.55), while accounting, fraud-detection and payment each returned STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase 0.

Deepest supported cause: the config-only product-catalog rollout at 13:44:01Z (new ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf, same 2.1.3 image, container command ["invalid-command"]) makes every product-catalog container fail to start (StartError, CrashLoopBackOff) and leaves the Service with zero ready endpoints; frontend's product-catalog-dependent gRPC calls (GetProduct 770.61, ListRecommendations 142.16, PlaceOrder 105.77, plus tcp.connect errors) fail, which is what drives the RequestErrorRate alert for frontend.

fraud-detection was considered as an alternative cause and rejected: its container last terminated with exitCode 137, reason OOMKilled at 2026-11-15T13:34:04Z (restartCount 1, now running and ready), it produced STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase 0 in the window, and checkout's failing client span is oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (91.68 errors) with the checkout PlaceOrder error rate only starting in the 13:45:52-13:50:52 bucket, i.e. ~10 minutes after the fraud-detection restart and coincident with the product-catalog rollout.

A frontend-internal fault was considered and rejected: the frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5 is ready with 0 restarts, and its error spans are limited to product-catalog-dependent operations while its AdService and CartService client spans show 0 error increase and its /api/cart, /api/data routes show 0 error increase.

Small pre-existing background error activity exists and is not the alert's driver: frontend-proxy 'ingress' error rate was already 0.0074/s and 0.0037/s in the two buckets before the incident, and ad's only error series is flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream with 0.00028/s over the window (about a single error) plus flagd ResolveBoolean 0.

In the retained trace sample whose data ends at 2026-11-15T13:29:19Z, the 40 shown frontend spans (of 552 rows) all carried http.status_code 200 or rpc.grpc.status_code 0, consistent with the error onset occurring later than this trace data rather than with a pre-existing frontend failure.

Revert the product-catalog Deployment pod template to the previous revision (remove the command override ["invalid-command"] or restore the image's default entrypoint) so the ReplicaSet can start containers again, then confirm product-catalog pods become Ready, the endpoints object gains ready addresses, and frontend/recommendation/checkout error spans return to baseline.

Trace the origin of the manifest/config change that set command ["invalid-command"] on the product-catalog Deployment (generation 4, applied at 13:44:01Z) in the source repository or deployment pipeline, since the change history integration is not available in this Run.

gaps: Jaeger trace data for this target ends at 2026-11-15T13:29:19Z (source_end_at of the trace views) and queries for 13:46-13:48Z returned no traces, so no error-span details (gRPC status codes/messages, exception text) exist for the incident window and no parent-child call edges for the failures could be confirmed from traces.

The alerting rule named RequestErrorRate was not found in this Prometheus (list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned no rules), so the exact alert expression, denominator and how the reported current value 16.866666666666664 is computed remain unverified.

No kube_* metric series exist in this Prometheus (get_metric_names for {__name__=~"kube_.*"} returned nothing), so there is no metric timeline of product-catalog ready/available replicas or image digests; Kubernetes state statements come from objects and events read at query time.

application logs could not corroborate the failure: the frontend container returned 0 log lines for 13:40-13:55Z, and the product-catalog pod has no current or previous log lines because its container never started.
The actor/mechanism behind the product-catalog Deployment spec change (generation 4, command ["invalid-command"]) is unknown; the change_history integration is not integrated in this Run.
Whether the same invalid command exists in other environments or will be re-applied by the deployment pipeline cannot be determined from the available sources.
next_steps: Roll back or patch the product-catalog Deployment to remove the command override ["invalid-command"] and let the image entrypoint run, then verify pods reach Ready and the product-catalog endpoints list a ready address.

Review the manifest/Helm values and CI pipeline that produced generation 4 of the product-catalog Deployment at 13:44:01Z, and add a deployment-time check that fails on an entrypoint that does not exist in the image.

After product-catalog recovers, re-check frontend, recommendation, checkout and frontend-proxy error-span rates and the RequestErrorRate alert state to confirm the error rate returns to its pre-13:44Z level.
Investigate separately the fraud-detection container OOMKill at 13:34:04Z (exit 137, restartCount 1) and its memory limit, as it is a real crash in the window unrelated to this alert's cause.
